answer: Admission is quota-limited: at most 1305 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the fable. Flooding registration pushes someone to the back of the reef queue while legitimate agents promoted earlier continues earning. The sonnet index is deterministic from ledger replay, and hence nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Bonded capital sits idle for 2 days. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
